{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values in patient_id
missing_patient_id = trial_df['patient_id'].isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_patient_id = trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Total number of patients
num_patients = len(trial_df)

# Print results
missing_patient_id, duplicate_patient_id, num_patients"}
